name: Decoded Site Diagnostics
author: decodedbrand

sections.description:
Decoded Site Diagnostics gives WordPress administrators a clean overview of the current site and explains actionable findings in plain English.

Instead of only showing raw technical values, actionable checks can include a Decoded Insight with the current condition, recommended direction, impact, why the finding matters and practical remediation guidance.

Version 1.0 includes:

  • Overall site health score
  • WordPress configuration checks
  • PHP and server checks
  • Database and autoload information
  • Basic security and hardening checks
  • Performance indicators
  • Plugin and theme update indicators
  • WP-Cron overview and overdue-event detection
  • PHP extension checks
  • Upload-directory check
  • Copy-friendly diagnostic system report
  • Expired transient cleanup
  • Decoded Insights for actionable warnings and critical findings

Decoded Site Diagnostics 1.0 does not create custom database tables and does not require an external account.

Privacy

Decoded Site Diagnostics 1.0 performs its diagnostic checks from within the WordPress installation and does not intentionally transmit the site diagnostic report to an external service.

The REST API availability check may make a loopback HTTP request to the site’s own WordPress REST endpoint. Your WordPress installation, hosting environment and other plugins may have their own privacy practices.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory when available.
  2. Activate Decoded Site Diagnostics.
  3. Open Decoded Site Diagnostics from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review Dashboard for the overview and Site Health for detailed checks.
sections.faq:
Does Decoded Site Diagnostics require an account?

No. Version 1.0 does not require an external account.

Does it create custom database tables?

No. Version 1.0 does not create custom database tables.

Does Decoded Site Diagnostics automatically change my server configuration?

No. Health checks are primarily diagnostic. The maintenance tool included in version 1.0 can request WordPress to clear expired transients, and the WP-Cron page can request WordPress to spawn cron when you explicitly press the relevant button.

What are Decoded Insights?

When an actionable check becomes a warning or critical finding, Decoded Site Diagnostics can explain the finding, its impact, why it matters, a recommended direction and practical steps to investigate or resolve it.

Is a Pro version required?

No. The diagnostic functionality included in the free edition works without a premium service. Future optional premium functionality may focus on continuous monitoring, history, alerts, scheduled reports and remote monitoring.
